cases.purpose: Independent pinned GNU Bash read -s control on the same controlling-PTY boundary: Ctrl-C restores the complete initial terminal state.
cases.oracle: Pinned unmodified GNU Bash 5.3.20 read -s, original PTY termios and raw SIGINT status.
cases.comparison: Exact expectation for status and output derived independently of the candidate; raw stdout, stderr and fixture files are retained as diagnostics.
cases.script:
guard_guest() {
  local token vendor virt inside outside length extra
  local -a uid_rows
  [[ -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || return 125
  IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || return 125
  IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || return 125
  [[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || return 125
  (( UID == EUID )) || return 125
  if (( EUID == 0 )); then
    mapfile -t uid_rows </proc/self/uid_map || return 125
    (( ${#uid_rows[@]} == 1 )) || return 125
    read -r inside outside length extra <<<"${uid_rows[0]}" || return 125
    [[ $inside == 0 && $outside == 2000 && $length == 1 && -z $extra ]] || return 125
  else
    (( EUID == 2000 )) || return 125
  fi
  virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || return 125
  [[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || return 125
}
guard_guest || { printf 'refusing non-fixture guest\n' >&2; exit 125; }
[[ $(/usr/bin/sha256sum /opt/bash-5.3.20/bin/bash) == '25a9bcfbdb3d52798022550336c8110461d533cf7b5c90e336b117aabee559d8  /opt/bash-5.3.20/bin/bash' ]] || exit 125
exec /opt/bash-5.3.20/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c 'read -r -s -p "New password: " ignored'
cases.setup_script:
set -e
mk() { local sh; sh=$(printf '%s' "$1" | /usr/bin/od -An -tx1 | /usr/bin/tr -d ' \n'); printf '$argon2id$v=19$m=19456,t=2,p=1$%s$%s' "$sh" "$(printf '%s' "$2" | /usr/bin/argon2 "$1" -id -t 2 -k 19456 -p 1 -l 32 -r)"; }
old=$(mk w5saltw5salt1234 'qvx-old-5521'); other=$(mk w5saltother9876 'oth-pass-3377')
printf 'w5user:%s:19000:0:99999:7:::\nother:%s:19000:0:99999:7:::\n' "$old" "$other" > shadow
printf 'w5user:x:1000:1000:W5:/home/w5user:/bin/sh\nother:x:1001:1001::/home/other:/bin/sh\n' > passwd
cp shadow shadow.orig; chmod 600 shadow shadow.orig
